name: simply walk around it [UPD]
desc:
the official obby from Electracy that includes multiple levels getting progressively harder. Can you beat this while jump is disabled? 

hint: you have to simply just walk around to complete these levels

TIP: on pc you can use"," and "." buttons to automatically align your camera!

all tutorials for each level can be found on the Electracy channel

scripts.title: ENABLE JUMP KEYLESS
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function jump(character)
    if not character then return end
    
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
        
        humanoid.JumpPower = 50
    end
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    jump(LocalPlayer.Character)
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(jump)
